scope: Fixed-protocol follow-up after the three-seed development gate; historical biological results on these chromosomes are already known, so this is not untouched external validation.
launch_rule: Manual review of the completed development report, including full-versus-coordinate contrasts, followed by explicit launch. Require the original all-seed trained-minus-random gate to pass. No performance-based omission or early stopping of replication jobs.
exposure_reason: Fold-A biological validation used chr2, chr7, chr12, chr17 and chr22, which constitute fold-B test chromosomes. Report fold B and all-five-fold summaries separately as development-exposed sensitivity results.
representation: E denotes the 48D sequence-conditioned masked-feature encoder. Native cst/csht names are compatibility aliases for C+S+E and C+S+H+E.
training: Reuse the completed fold-A encoders; initialize every other fold from scratch with the exact development architecture, targets, optimizer, mask rate and epoch/patience budget. Checkpoint selection uses self-supervised validation only. No biological labels enter encoder training.
inputs: Original graph, benchmark manifest and benchmark NT cache remain checksum-pinned; do not substitute the separately completed whole-graph NT cache or expand graph contexts in this experiment.
probe: Same native frozen cCRE and INS/DEL probes, balanced logistic regression, max_iter=4000, original feature joins/calibration/validation-selected thresholds, identical examples and baseline predictions across arms.
inference: Use existing paired hierarchical fold/seed bootstrap, exact sign flips on seed-averaged folds, and BH adjustment within metric and summary scope. Seeds are not independent genomic replicates. All confidence intervals are exploratory pointwise estimates, not a new superiority or NMI acceptance gate.
limitations: Model family was chosen adaptively after earlier null/negative studies
Primary four-fold aggregate excludes the directly development-exposed fold B but does not erase historical label exposure
Coordinate-only ablation also removes graph-stream capacity
No strict-context, donor-excluded or external-resource result is implied
